description.intro: The Nike FC Barcelona Phoenix Fleece Hoodie CE for Women combines an oversized design with medium-weight brushed fleece for exceptional comfort at any time of the day. Its soft interior, adjustable hood and full zipper closure make it a perfect garment for Barcelona fans looking for comfort and style.
key_benefits: Phoenix Fleece Fabric: Very soft brushed interior for a warm and comfortable feel.
Oversize design: Roomy, modern fit for greater comfort.
Full zipper: Allows you to easily regulate ventilation and facilitates use.
Front pockets: Ideal for storing small items or keeping your hands warm.
Embroidered FC Barcelona crest: High quality official finish.

Diseño oversize: Ajuste amplio y moderno para una mayor comodidad.
Cremallera completa: Permite regular fácilmente la ventilación y facilita su uso.
Bolsillos frontales: Ideales para guardar pequeños objetos o mantener las manos calientes.
